title: Fields shared by every content entry

id.description: Short unique name used by the code. Lower-case letters, digits and hyphens only. Never change an id once it is in use.

text.description: Plain-language text shown to players. Short sentences.

sourced.description: Every entry must say where its figures come from.

source.description: URL or document name for the entry's figures. Required.

retrieved.description: Date the source was read, as YYYY-MM-DD.

estimated.description: true if any figure in the entry is not taken directly from the source. Must then also be listed in docs/model-assumptions.md.

estimate_basis.description: Which figures are estimated and how they were worked out.

notes.description: Notes for the team. Never shown to players.
